LAYOUT BLOCKS                           
─────────────                           
                                        
Left column                             
                                        
The left column stacks a heading above a
paragraph that wraps at the narrower    
golden widths.                          
────────────────────────────────────────
Right column                            
                                        
The right column is separated from the  
left by a light hairline rule between   
the two stacked groups.                 
                                        
One.                                    
────────────────────────────────────────
Two.                                    
────────────────────────────────────────
Three.                                  
                                        
A single column renders with no         
separator rule at all.
